description: This file defines the VLookup class, which implements the VLOOKUP function for spreadsheet calculations, including methods for searching and sorting lookup data.

classes.name: VLookup
classes.description: Class implementing the VLOOKUP spreadsheet function, including search and sort methods.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a VLOOKUP operation, searching for a value in a lookup array and returning a corresponding value based on the index number.

methods.name: vlookupSort
methods.description: Sorts lookup array entries based on the first column, used for non-exact match lookups.

methods.name: vLookupSearch
methods.description: Searches for a lookup value within the lookup array, returning the row number of the match.
